subject: general
question: The H.C.F. and the L.C.M. of two numbers are 28 and 336, respectively. If one of the numbers is 112, find the other one.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Product of **H.C.F.** and **L.C.M.** = Product of the **two numbers**.

Other number = (**H.C.F.** × **L.C.M.**) ÷ **Given number**

Other number = (28 × 336) ÷ 112

Other number = 336 ÷ 4 = 84

**∴ The correct answer is 84.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**H.C.F.** = 28

**L.C.M.** = 336

**First Number** (A) = 112

**Formula Used:**

A × B = **H.C.F.** × **L.C.M.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e4daeca1d51c4faf447d674a53edb61983fd7992674e21c0c400adf37e18f40.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 112 × Second Number = 28 × 336

⇒ Second Number = (28 × 336) ÷ 112

⇒ Second Number = 9408 ÷ 112

⇒ Second Number = 84

**∴ The correct answer is 84.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

H.C.F. and L.C.M. Property

For any two positive integers a and b, H.C.F.(a, b) × L.C.M.(a, b) = a × b. This is only applicable to **exactly two numbers**.

Co-prime Numbers

If two numbers are **co-prime**, their H.C.F. is always 1 and their L.C.M. is the product of the numbers.

H.C.F. of Fractions

H.C.F. = (H.C.F. of Numerators) ÷ (L.C.M. of Denominators).</p
